name: Burning and Suppression of Solids
objective: Study burning and extinction characteristics of solid fuel samples in microgravity
source_note: NASA CIR chamber inserts include a dedicated BASS chamber

name: Burning and Suppression of Solids II
objective: Extend BASS findings to additional solid fuel geometries and flow conditions
source_note: Follow-on investigation to BASS using the same CIR facility

name: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
platform: ISS Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) - Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus
objective: Analyze the effectiveness of fire suppressants on droplet flames; discovered a class of low-temperature flames that persist after visible flame extinction
source_note: NASA reports FLEX led to the discovery of cool flames that continue after visible extinction

name: Flame Extinguishment Experiment 2
objective: Further investigate cool-flame chemistry and suppressant effectiveness identified in FLEX
source_note: Follow-on to FLEX studying cool flame behavior in more depth

name: Spacecraft Fire Safety Demonstration
platform: Uncrewed Cygnus cargo spacecraft (post ISS departure)
objective: Investigate large-scale flame growth and material flammability limits in a real spacecraft environment where crew risk is not a concern
source_note: NASA describes Saffire as enabling flame-spread studies at a scale not possible with a crew aboard

name: ACME Burning Rate Emulator
objective: Study fire prevention by simulating flammability of solid and liquid materials using gaseous fuel analogs under representative conditions
source_note: One of five independent gaseous-flame studies conducted under the ACME project

name: Solid Fuel Ignition and Extinction - Growth and Extinction Limits
platform: ISS Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) - SoFIE chamber
objective: Analyze how fuel temperature and geometry affect material flammability and flame growth/extinction limits
fuel_or_material: Solid fuel samples: flat sheets, thick slabs, cylinders, spheres
source_note: First investigation in the SoFIE series; NASA reports results agree with model predictions

name: Solid Fuel Ignition and Extinction - Material Ignition and Suppression Test
platform: ISS Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR) - SoFIE chamber
objective: Determine methods to control and suppress fires aboard the ISS by studying ignition and extinction of solid fuel under varying flow and atmosphere
source_note: Focused specifically on fire suppression and control strategies for ISS
